updates.title: External ID is not a secret
updates.note: External ID identifies the vendor’s customer in a trust-policy condition. Bukan password; vendor should generate a unique value for each customer to prevent the confused deputy problem.

updates.title: ForAllValues does not require every allowed tag
updates.note: It validates all supplied values against the allowed set. It can be true when the key is absent. Untuk mewajibkan tag, add existence checks and explicit required RequestTag conditions.

updates.title: ACM public certificates can be exportable
updates.note: Exportable public certificates can be deployed to EC2 and outside AWS; fees apply. Kamu must distribute renewed exported certificates to those endpoints. The old blanket “cannot export public ACM certificates” is incomplete.

updates.title: S3 has native EventBridge events
updates.note: Enable EventBridge delivery on the S3 bucket and route events with rules. CloudTrail data events are a different path, bukan mandatory prerequisite for native S3 events.

updates.title: S3 Object Lambda has customer eligibility restrictions
updates.note: Since 7 November 2025, availability is limited to existing customers and selected APN partners. Pahami pattern transform-on-read, but do not assume a new customer can adopt this service.

updates.title: Lambda CPU and payload numbers need correction
updates.note: 1,769 MB provides one vCPU equivalent, not two. Standard invocation duration remains up to 15 minutes. Current asynchronous invocation payload limit is 1 MB; synchronous request/response limits differ. Bedakan quota, adjustable concurrency, and application requirements.

updates.title: ALB supports mutual TLS
updates.note: ALB supports certificate verification and passthrough modes. Jadi “only Classic Load Balancer supports two-way TLS” is outdated. Match certificate handling and target needs to the mode.

updates.title: ALB cross-zone has target-group controls
updates.note: Cross-zone is on at the ALB level. It can be disabled for eligible target groups, with feature restrictions. Jangan menghafal “impossible to disable anywhere.”

updates.title: 29 seconds is not universal for REST integrations
updates.note: Regional and private REST API integration timeouts can be increased beyond 29 seconds; this may require a lower account throttle quota. Edge-optimized REST APIs retain the 29-second maximum. Tanyakan API type terlebih dahulu.

updates.title: Prefer CloudFront trusted key groups
updates.note: Use trusted key groups for signed URLs/cookies. Your application signs using its private key; it does not call CloudFront to create each URL. Root-account key pairs are a legacy alternative, bukan required design.

updates.title: RDS Multi-AZ depends on deployment type
updates.note: A Multi-AZ DB instance has a standby that does not serve reads. A Multi-AZ DB cluster has two readable standby instances. Bedakan this from a read replica and from Aurora architecture.

updates.title: Express workflow delivery semantics have two modes
updates.note: Standard workflows use exactly-once workflow execution. Asynchronous Express uses at-least-once; synchronous Express uses at-most-once. External side effects still need careful retry and idempotency design.

updates.title: Snowball is restricted for new customers
updates.note: Since 7 November 2025, Snowball Edge is available only to existing customers. For a new project, evaluate current transfer options such as DataSync, Data Transfer Terminal, or partners. Slide device specifications are historical study context.

updates.title: VPC addressing is more flexible than RFC 1918
updates.note: Private RFC 1918 IPv4 ranges are recommended, not the only allowed ranges. Using a public range internally does not automatically make it internet-routable. Selalu check overlap and routing.

updates.title: AWS offers private IPv6 addressing
updates.note: AWS supports private IPv6 through IPAM as well as public IPv6. Private IPv6 is not advertised to the internet. Public IPv6 reachability still depends on routes and security rules; alamat global tidak otomatis terbuka.

updates.title: An API Gateway 502 is not a unique concurrency diagnosis
updates.note: With Lambda integration, function errors or malformed responses can produce 502. A rejected Lambda invocation produces 500 in the documented integration behavior. Lihat logs and metrics before choosing a fix.
